needle_meshes.n1_measured: needle_n1_measured.obj, generated from 0-b caliper values (pending); parameters + sha256 recorded when generated

psi_definition.primary: psi_kin = angle between the needle tangent t at the grasp point and the kinematic jaw axis (tool z of measured_cp, rotated to the camera frame by the calibration rotation) projected into the needle plane (normal n from the stereo arc fit); folded to [0, 90] deg
psi_definition.check: psi_img2d = image-plane angle between the projected needle tangent and the jaw axis measured in the physical-left rect image (Hough on jaw edges, r5_grasp_v3.dominant_line)
psi_definition.dropped: stereo triangulation of the jaw line: ill-conditioned (plane separation sin 0.04-0.06 at ~95 mm, B = 5.45 mm), seen in 0-a

deviations_from_plan_known_before_data: D1: 3090 unavailable -> 1-d, 1-f, 1-e, full 1-c postponed until it returns; no substitution of SGBM for FS.
D2: instrument is LND, not the R4 ProGrasp -> plan 1-b 'recheck the existing calibration' is replaced by 1-b' (new LND grid); the R4 calibration is not used for any robot step.
D3: 1-c split into 1-c' (tip-only, no needle) now and the full needle version later.

1a_SUJ.precondition: ECM retracted (record ECM js before/after); operator hand on e-stop
steps: record PSM1 SUJ js + /SUJ/PSM1/measured_cp + /SUJ/PSM1/local/measured_cp + /PSM1/measured_cp (10 s, static)
press the PSM1 SUJ clutch, push a small distance, release; record 10 s
restart dvrk_system (SIGINT, same JSON) only after user confirms; record 10 s after power-on
push back to the original place (clutch); record 10 s
1a_SUJ.rule: 'refreshes' after an action iff |change of SUJ measured_cp translation| >= 0.2 mm while the SUJ joints changed; facts only
1a_SUJ.after: ECM and both SUJs are fixed for the rest of the round; js/SUJ snapshot at start, after each group, at the end; any change voids the group

1b_prime_grid.poses: >= 36 poses: translation offsets within +-8 mm (x, y) and 0..-16 mm (z, away from pad) of a start pose above the work area, combined with wrist orientation offsets: instrument roll (joint 3) in {-60,-30,0,+30,+60} deg and pitch/yaw (joints 4/5) in {-30,0,+30} deg; exact list generated with seed 20261013 and written to 1b/manifest.json before the first move
1b_prime_grid.per_pose: 10 synced rect frames (mean saved) + measured_cp (position AND orientation) + local/measured_cp + measured_js + ECM js
1b_prime_grid.tip_detection: kinematic prediction -> local multi-template NCC + NCC disparity (no FS); poses where the automatic detection is not confident are clicked by hand on the mean image; method per pose is recorded
1b_prime_grid.holdout: random 25% of poses (seed 20261013) are test; 20 repeated random splits reported as distribution
report: TCP estimate with spread over splits
angle between kinematic jaw axis and image-measured jaw axis (2D projection comparison) vs roll angle
1b_prime_grid.abort: only preconditions (ECM/SUJ moved, tool fault, safety); no result gate

1c_prime_tip_only.placements: 3 positions x 2 roll angles, no needle needed
1c_prime_tip_only.moves: +-1 mm lateral, +-1 mm along jaw axis, +1 mm vertical (up only); return to origin after each; 3 frames per position
1c_prime_tip_only.report: measured/commanded ratio and direction error per direction; flag if ratio deviates > 10% or direction > 10 deg

safety: ECM retract before any scene change
slow motions; per-step translation <= 3 mm and rotation <= 10 deg per command
wrist roll/pitch/yaw changes only >= 10 mm above any surface
stop when outside the workspace box
no passwords in any file; 3090 only over existing SSH key
statistics: proportions with denominators and Wilson 95% CI; small samples are descriptive only
